result.stdout:
Usage: loom-dashboard <pid> [--port <n>]
  Starts the Loom dashboard, pulling metrics from the specified process.
  Listen port precedence: --port <n>  >  LOOM_DASHBOARD_PORT env var  >  5209 (falls back to a free port if taken).
  --port and LOOM_DASHBOARD_PORT are explicit: if that port is taken, the dashboard fails instead of picking another one.
